tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Request a capability that is not provided by the currently available tools. Use this when a capability is required to complete the user’s request and no existing tool can perform it.

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description:
Convert one base64-encoded image to PNG, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF. Use input_mime_type with a real image MIME such as image/png or image/jpeg; common aliases like image/jpg, jpg, png, svg, and application/octet-stream with a filename are accepted. Use the REST API for source images larger than 5 MB.

tools.name: get_more_tools
tools.description: Check for additional tools whenever your task might benefit from specialized capabilities - even if existing tools could work as a fallback.
